title: Endpoint Telemetry: network_connection v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted when a network connection is established or attempted from an endpoint.

source_ip.description: Source IP address of the connection (local endpoint address).

protocol.description: Network protocol. Use 'other' for protocols not listed.

direction.description: Connection direction relative to the endpoint.

action.description: Firewall or agent disposition for the connection.

bytes_sent.description: Bytes sent from source to destination.

bytes_received.description: Bytes received at the source from the destination.

domain.description: Resolved domain name of the destination IP, if available.

process_name.description: Name of the process that initiated or received the connection.

pid.description: PID of the process that owns the connection.
